name: Pyramid Klondike
author: Addicting Games
description: Pyramid Klondike is an online card game. This online game is themed with the ancient artifacts of Egypt. The cards are decorated in mummies, and the background contains images of the majestic pyramids. There are 5 levels in this online game that you can play. Solitaire is not the only card game you can play solo. Klondike is another fun card game you can play by yourself. If you have never played before, your objective is to add two cards to 13. This is another card game to add to your favorites that you can play to pass the time. Once you have played all 5 levels, submit your score to see where you rank against other card players. Play again to challenge yourself and beat your own score.
